text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A result like this is nowhere near good enough
to be called an 'Empress'...!"
choice_data_list: I'll become someone who's good enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of victory or defeat, there is always the next race.
Dwelling on a loss will only cause problems...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I admit that.
However, I have no intention of casting these feelings aside.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This frustration, this resentment...
I swear I will channel it into triumph in my next run!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
"Become worthy of being the Empress," is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What a completely thoughtless and short-sighted conclusion...
How truly like you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, the truth must be simple.
If I am lacking, then I must become enough...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must devote myself even further to my training.
